xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: The Assistant Commissioner, State Tax, Sector-3, Mobile Squad-5, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: As per the order received by the Company, a penalty of INR 123,803 has been imposed
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Asstt. Commissioner, State Tax, Sector-3, Mobile Squad – 5, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh detained the truck during transit checking. Further, since the vehicle was not carrying valid reference on ‘E-Way Bill’, it was detained, and penalty was imposed. The Company has paid the penalty amount to secure release of the detained vehicle. Penalty amounting to Rs. 73,613/- shall be recovered from the transporter and the rest shall be borne by the company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company do not envisage any relevant impact on financial, operations or other activities of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: The Superintendent, CGST, Range-I, Division-X, Anand, Vadodara, Gujarat
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: A demand order was received for an aggregate amount of INR 932,958 (which includes tax demand of INR 466,479 and penalty of INR 466,479)
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Certain goods in the custody of retailers had expired/damaged for which the Company had compensated the loss to the retailers through Company’s stockiest. The Superintendent, CGST has now directed to reverse proportionate input tax credit on such goods in terms of Section 17 (5) of the CGST Act 2017 and pay such tax credit towards GST demand for the period pertaining to FY 2018-19 to FY 2022-23.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: In view of the Company, the aforesaid demand is not maintainable and the Company shall be filing an appeal before the 1st Appellate Authority. There is no impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company due to this Order. The Company has strong merits in the case and is likely to get favorable order in higher forums.
